latest_release.name: PaperKnife+ v1.2
latest_release.body:
## PaperKnife+ v1.2

A privacy-first update focused on the viewer, tool screens, and release polish.
Still 100% offline — no accounts, no uploads, no tracking.

### Added
- Customizable Home tools: choose 0–8 tools and arrange your own grid (#26)
- New task picker for processing the currently open PDF
- Compress size estimate: original vs. compressed size and percentage saved
- Watermark color picker, including template watermarks
- In-app text reader for PDF-to-Text history entries
- Viewer: find-in-document, print, pinch zoom, and page-jump controls (#7)

### Improved
- Redesigned navigation, Home, and Tools screens
- Shared tool headers and cleaner, less-scrolling tool layouts
- Sign/Watermark placement now uses exact page bounds and the PDF crop box
- Redesigned password prompt with show/hide and inline errors
- History now opens ZIP and text outputs correctly
- About and Hall of Fame rebuilt
- Support links now open the dedicated support page

### Fixed
- Tools page grid/list toggle now works; list is the default (#3)
- Readability and contrast improvements across labels and descriptions (#20)
- Recent Activity now opens the History tab instead of a blank overlay (#24)
- Search highlights now align correctly on the right and bottom edges
- PageLightbox no longer crashes with “Size is unspecified”
- PageLightbox bottom controls clear the Android navigation bar
- Lock tool password field no longer clips text
- Metadata save button stays visible, and fields no longer clip text
- Long file names are ellipsized instead of pushing controls off-screen
- Watermark lightbox controls no longer overflow or wrap awkwardly

### Testing
- Play closed testing is now open — join the Google Group and opt in (#19)

detail.readme:
PaperKnife+

A private PDF workshop for Android.

21 tools. 100% offline. No accounts, no uploads, no tracking.

--- ## A quick look

--- ## Why PaperKnife+ Most PDF apps want your files on their servers. PaperKnife+ does the opposite. Every tool runs on your phone using the native PDF engine. Your contracts, receipts, notes, and scans never leave your device. There is no account, no cloud, no analytics, and no INTERNET permission in the app. It works on a plane, in a basement, or anywhere else with no signal. --- ## Tools | Category | What you can do | |---|---| | **Edit** | Merge, split, delete pages, rearrange, rotate, sign, watermark, add page numbers, edit bookmarks | | **Optimize** | Compress with estimated savings, grayscale, repair corrupted files, compare two PDFs | | **Secure** | Lock with a password, remove passwords, edit metadata | | **Convert** | PDF to images, images to PDF, PDF to ZIP, extract embedded images, PDF to text | | **Viewer** | Find in document, print, pinch zoom, jump to page, open any tool directly on the current PDF | --- ## Download **Latest release: v1.2** - **Android:** 7.0+ (minSdk 24) - **Target:** Android 16 (API 36) - **Size:** about 8 MB - **License:** GPL-3.0-or-later --- ## Verify the APK GitHub release APKs are signed with the PaperKnife+ signing key. Signing certificate SHA-256: ```text 6B:AD:1D:71:9A:8B:B9:7C:73:FA:60:AA:08:B2:B0:D7:33:C7:75:3B:0F:C6:74:A1:30:6F:CD:94:62:23:8A:F8 ``` Verify a downloaded APK with: ```bash apksigner verify --print-certs PaperKnife+.apk ``` This confirms the signer identity. It does not verify the exact file contents. F-Droid builds are signed separately by F-Droid. --- ## Support PaperKnife+ PaperKnife+ is free, ad-free, and built in spare time. If it saves you a little work, you can help keep it going:

Every contribution helps keep PaperKnife+ free and offline. You can also help by reporting bugs, suggesting tools, sharing the app, or joining the [Play testing group](https://groups.google.com/g/paperknife-tester). After joining, opt in on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.paperknifeplus.app). --- ## Development PaperKnife+ is built with: - Kotlin + Jetpack Compose - PDFBox-Android + Android `PdfRenderer` - Coil with a custom PDF page fetcher - MinSdk 24, compile/target SDK 36 - GitHub Actions for release builds Build locally with JDK 17: ```bash ./gradlew assembleDebug ``` Issues and pull requests are welcome: --- ## License PaperKnife+ is free software under the **GNU General Public License v3.0 or later**. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for the full text.
Made with care, entirely offline.
